title: US stocks close up on Iran diplomacy hopes; tech leads rebound
title_zh: 伊朗外交希望推动美股收盘；科技股引领反弹

title: Big Tech signs Trump's AI energy cost pledge
title_zh: 大型科技公司签署特朗普的人工智能能源成本承诺
summary: President Trump announced a new "ratepayer protection pledge," saying energy demand tied to AI data centers could more than triple by 2035, promising American households won't see higher electricity bills as a result.
summary_zh: 特朗普总统宣布了一项新的“纳税人保护承诺”，称到 2035 年，与人工智能数据中心相关的能源需求可能会增加两倍以上，并承诺美国家庭不会因此而面临更高的电费。

title: BofA reinstates Tesla coverage on robotaxi prospects
title_zh: 美国银行恢复特斯拉对机器人出租车前景的报道
summary: Bank of America analysts are all in on Tesla (TSLA), reinstating a new bullish coverage of the EV stock with a Buy rating. Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian covers the latest Wall Street buzz over Tesla's expanding robotaxi services.
summary_zh: 美国银行分析师全神贯注于特斯拉 (TSLA)，恢复了对该电动汽车股票的新看涨评级，给予买入评级。雅虎财经高级汽车记者 Pras Subramanian 报道了华尔街有关特斯拉不断扩大的机器人出租车服务的最新动态。

title: Amazon cuts more jobs; this time in robotics unit
title_zh: 亚马逊裁员更多；这次在机器人单元
summary: SAN FRANCISCO, March 4 (Reuters) - Amazon on Tuesday confirmed it laid off staff across its robotics unit, ‌with at least 100 white-collar jobs affected, two people ‌familiar with the matter told Reuters.
summary_zh: 路透旧金山 3 月 4 日 - 两位知情人士告诉路透，亚马逊周二证实，其机器人部门裁员，至少 100 名白领工作受到影响。

title: Broadcom sees over $100 billion in AI chip sales by 2027 on robust custom chip demand
title_zh: 由于定制芯片需求强劲，博通预计到 2027 年 AI 芯片销售额将超过 1000 亿美元
summary: Chip designer Broadcom on Wednesday projected its artificial intelligence chip revenue would exceed $100 billion next year, signaling surging demand for custom chips in a market dominated by Nvidia.
summary_zh: 芯片设计商博通周三预计，明年其人工智能芯片收入将超过 1000 亿美元，这表明由 Nvidia 主导的市场对定制芯片的需求激增。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq rebound on hopes of Iran deescalation as bitcoin surges
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数因比特币飙升而伊朗局势缓和的希望而反弹
summary: Investors are weighing a NYT report that Iran has indirectly approached the US to discuss terms for ending the conflict.
summary_zh: 投资者正在权衡《纽约时报》的一篇报道，该报道称伊朗已间接与美国接触，讨论结束冲突的条款。

title: Tech stocks today: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang suggests end of OpenAI investments, Apple unveils MacBook Neo
title_zh: 今日科技股：英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋建议结束 OpenAI 投资，苹果推出 MacBook Neo
summary: All eyes are on Nvidia's fourth quarter results, due after the closing bell on Wednesday, as AI concerns continue to grip markets.
summary_zh: 由于人工智能担忧继续困扰市场，所有目光都集中在英伟达将于周三收盘后公布的第四季度业绩。

title: Moderna reaches vaccine settlement, GitLab's guidance disappoints
title_zh: Moderna 达成疫苗和解协议，GitLab 的指导令人失望
summary: Yahoo Finance anchor Josh Lipton tracks today's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute. US stock exchanges, in particular the NASDAQ (^IXIC, ^GSPC, ^DJI), climb following jobs data and news of potential Iran-US negotiations.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经主播乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 在本《市场分钟》中追踪当今走势最强劲的股票和最大的市场故事。美国股市，尤其是纳斯达克（^IXIC、^GSPC、^DJI），在就业数据和伊朗与美国潜在谈判的消息传出后上涨。

title: CPUs are back en vogue in the data center
title_zh: CPU 在数据中心重新流行
summary: CPUs are back in style thanks to AI.
summary_zh: 得益于人工智能，CPU 又重新流行起来。
